current-project.purpose: Freeze the current project UUID and project metadata.

current-document.purpose: Freeze document UUID, document type and active tab identity.

argumentPolicy: componentType omitted unless the intent requires a specific enum member
components-current-page.purpose: Read components from the active schematic page only.

component-by-id.purpose: Read one or more identified schematic components.

component-pins.purpose: Read component pin definitions and connections.

attributes-by-parent.purpose: Read visible and hidden attributes for an identified parent primitive.

wires-current-page.purpose: Read wires from the active schematic page.

nets-current-page.purpose: Read normalized net information for the active schematic context.

preconditions: JLC Hardware Learning image-to-EasyEDA coordinate transform is calibrated
the referenced image and live document UUID identify the same page snapshot
primitives-in-region.purpose: Narrow live primitive evidence to a calibrated schematic region.

primitive-bounds.purpose: Compute EasyEDA-side bounds for already identified primitives.

netlist-text.enumPolicy: Use ESYS_NetlistType.PROTEL2 or another named enum member; never use a raw string or number.
netlist-text.purpose: Build a deterministic topology graph when primitive-level evidence is insufficient.

argumentPolicy: fileType must use ESCH_ExportDocumentFileType.PNG, SVG or PDF
object defaults to the live-verified Current Schematic scope
Current Schematic Page PNG, PDF and SVG are blocked before bridge execution on the installed profile because page scope is a known hang
Current Schematic SVG is documented but unverified; do not substitute an EPRO-derived visual
ordinary typed plans must reject this deprecated method
only the fixed export adapter may save the returned File with force=false
schematic-export.purpose: Capture a traceable schematic visual artifact; it represents a page only when one-page evidence or a verified page-scope export exists.

preconditions: deviceUuid is present in component evidence
libraryUuid is present or the API can resolve the device unambiguously
library-device-by-id.purpose: Enrich an identified component with library metadata.

compare-options.note: External datasheet or procurement lookup is a separate evidence provider and is never inferred from JLC Hardware Learning or EasyEDA alone.
